pages.text: Taishang Life Balance is an immortal Pure active spell. Click-cast marks the target with blood chains; for 30 seconds, the caster loses 10% max health per second and converts that loss into amplified damage.

Holding the spell chains caster and target together. Both cannot move but can still look around, cast, and use pills. Qingdi absorption is consumed first; when the caster reaches 1 health, both health losses stop.
